description: This file defines an Angular service called ApiClient that provides methods for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) to a backend API. It uses dependency injection for HttpClient and constructs API URLs based on environment variables.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: An Angular service class that provides generic methods for making HTTP API calls (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE).

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified API endpoint with optional parameters and headers.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request to the specified API endpoint with a request body and optional parameters.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs a PUT request to the specified API endpoint with a request body and optional parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to the specified API endpoint with optional parameters and headers.
